diagram_candidates.verdict: optional pedagogical candidate; not needed for proof validity
diagram_candidates.source_claim: For two arbitrary upper-half-plane charge assignments, the degree-completed Hall products over decreasing semistable phases agree; after Euler or skew integration, the completed ordered products are equal and induce the same continuous automorphism by conjugation.
diagram_candidates.why: The main content is a comparison of two phase-ordered factorizations, and the statement links their equality to equality of induced automorphisms. A small schematic could help readers keep the two orderings and map from Hall product to quantum-torus automorphism distinct.
diagram_candidates.specific_content: Use two abstract phase-ray panels labeled Z_- and Z_+, each with decreasing-phase factors S_Z(phi) in the order from equation (1) and an equality between their completed Hall products. Below, show I or J sending the equal products to the same unit A in the completed quantum torus, then conjugation x↦AxA^{-1}. Do not draw numerical rays or assert a specific wall-crossing path, since the theorem quantifies over arbitrary charge assignments and supplies no such path.
diagram_candidates.certainty: uncertain optional teaching aid, not a defect; abstract schematic only
diagram_candidates.local_image_evidence: screenshots/thm-finite-quiver-hall-wall-crossing--01.png and --02.png show the ordered-product statement/proof without a diagram
